items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This was Barbara Walter’s husband. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, husband.

ctx.x: Yeah, somewhere in there. What they said was true, they put Billy’s name up there. I was second to Billy…Lee somebody was the owner.
Yeah, husband. He had quite a lot of . . . he was pretty well known and pretty wealthy guy, a lot of holdings in Philadelphia and elsewhere.
